title: Set Fleet up without the connector
breadcrumb: Set Fleet up without the connector

slides.title: What these slides are for
slides.html: These slides set Fleet up for Deploy App by hand, for when the connector cannot be used. It takes technical staff, in Fleet's console.

slides.title: Start with a team
slides.html: Make a team named after your deployment, such as golden-monkey DeployApp: Settings, Fleets, Add fleet. Open enrolment in Deploy App to see the SCEP URL and the Challenge.

slides.title: Add Deploy App as an authority
slides.html: In Fleet: Settings, Integrations, Certificate enrollment, Add CA. Choose Custom Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP), with Deploy App's SCEP URL and Challenge.

slides.title: Add the certificate
slides.html: Choose your team at the top, then Controls, OS settings, Certificates, Add. Name rmscep, subject CN=$FLEET_VAR_HOST_END_USER_IDP_USERNAME_LOCAL_PART, OU=$FLEET_VAR_HOST_UUID.

slides.title: Add the policy
slides.html: In Configuration profiles press Add profile and add the policy part of the connector's template.json, with your Deploy App's name, such as golden-monkey.example.fi, for {domain} and rmscep for {key_alias}.

slides.title: Choose the apps
slides.html: Controls, Setup experience, Install software, Android, with your team chosen: tick Chrome and the apps your unit uses. They install when a phone enrols, and at no other time.

slides.title: Let Chrome use the certificate
slides.html: Without a setting of its own, Chrome does not send the certificate. Under Software, with your team chosen, open Google Chrome, then Actions and Edit configuration.

slides.title: Chrome's setting
slides.html: Give Google Chrome the config part of Chrome in template.json, inside managedConfiguration, with your Deploy App's address, such as https://mtls.golden-monkey.example.fi, for {mtls_url}. Press Save.

slides.title: No Deploy App icon by hand
slides.html: Fleet's console cannot make the Deploy App icon: that takes the connector or Fleet's API. Without it, people open work Chrome and type your Deploy App's address.

slides.title: Then enrol and name
slides.html: Phones can now enrol: see Add phones in Fleet. Name them in Fleet too: see Name phones in Fleet without the connector.
